sections.title: Title and suit
sections.line: Crowley on the card’s title (pdf p176); on the suit and its element (pdf p24).

quotes.quote: In the Wand suit, the card is called Completion.
“Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;

sections.title: Its place on the Tree and in the zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on Chesed in the suit of Fire and on Venus in Aries (pdf p188).

quotes.quote: This card refers to Chesed in the suit of Fire.
It is also referred to Venus in Aries

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley on the card below the Abyss (pdf p188); on the Fours and the Abyss (pdf p176).

quotes.quote: Being below the Abyss, it is the Lord of all manifested active Power.
